info.title: WRP Registration API
info.description:
API of the Wallet-Relying-Party (WRP) Registration backend of the
EUDI Wallet. The backend implements the roles "Registration Service"
and "Registrar" of the APTITUDE Onboarding Process.

Representatives of Organizations that participate in APTITUDE
register, log in via the OIDC service (Keycloak), create or join an
Organization, and submit applications to publish, edit, or revoke WRP
registration records. Applications are reviewed by the Registrar
using CLI tools that are not part of this API. Non-logged-in users
can read the published Register.

## Public Register (APTITUDE Common Register API)

The public read methods conform to the APTITUDE Common Register API:
`GET /wrp`, `GET /wrp/{identifier}` and `GET /wrp/check-intended-use`.
Their parameters, payload schemas and responses are taken from the
APTITUDE Register API OpenAPI specification (version 1.0.0).
Responses are JWS-signed statements (`application/jwt`), signed or
sealed by the Registrar; the signing certificate chain is carried in
the JWS `x5c` header. For convenience (e.g. for the registration
portal), the same payload is returned unsigned when the client sends
`Accept: application/json`. The write methods of the Common Register
API are not offered: registration records change only through
applications accepted by the Registrar.

## Register data (APTITUDE Register Data Schema)

Registration records follow the APTITUDE Register Data Schema
(`WalletRelyingParty`). The following data is provided by the
Registrar on acceptance, not by the applicant: `registryURI`, and the
`intendedUseIdentifier` and `createdAt` of new intended uses (and
`revokedAt` of ended ones). Published records additionally carry the
extension properties `wrpId`, `organizationId` and
`registrationCertificates`; `postalAddress` is excluded from
published statements.

The **WRP ID** is the value of one of the record's identifiers
(`identifier`), preferably the EUID where available. The applicant
states it when applying to publish a record, it cannot be removed or
changed by edits, and it is the `{identifier}` / `rpidentifier` used
to look the record up in the Common Register API.

## Registration certificates

Registration certificates (WRPRCs) are issued and revoked by the
Provider of WRPRC, not by this backend: one per intended use, only for
WRPs that are legal persons and where a WRPRC is required (CIR
2025/848, Article 8). They are issued after the create/edit
application is accepted, so that they carry the intended-use
identifiers assigned by the Register, and are then recorded by the
Registrar. Recorded certificates, including revoked ones, are visible
in the published record (`registrationCertificates`) and in the
Organization's view of its records.

## Authentication

All endpoints require an OIDC access token, except for:

* the public endpoints of the Common Register API (`/wrp...`)
* `POST /representatives` (registration)
* `POST /codes/validate` (validation of registration, email-change,
  and invitation codes)

Public endpoints are rate-limited. On every authenticated request the
access token is introspected, and the database is consulted to ensure
that the Representative is not deactivated and, where relevant, is a
member of the Organization.

get.summary: Search or list the published Register

parameters.description: Extension: filter by the Organization ID recorded in records.

get.description: Returns the published registration record whose WRP ID is `identifier`.

APTITUDE Common Register API intended-use check. The signed payload `data` is true if the given parameters match a currently valid intended use of the published registration record whose WRP ID is `rpidentifier`.

404.description: WRP with the given rpidentifier not found.

example.message: WRP with the given rpidentifier was not found.

post.description:
Registers a human Representative. The Representative is created in
the authentication service, and a validation code is sent to the
given email address. Login is possible after the code has been
validated via `POST /codes/validate`.

202.description: Registration accepted; a validation code was emailed.

409.description: A Representative with this email address already exists.

post.description:
Validates a code sent by email. Depending on the code, this:

* completes registration by validating the email address;
* completes an email address change (the new address replaces the
  old one in both the authentication service and the database);
* accepts an invitation, making the invited Representative a
  member of the Organization. This fails if the invited
  Representative already belongs to an Organization.

Codes are single-use, hard to guess, expire after 2 days, and
invitation codes are bound to the invited Representative.

200.description: The code was valid and its action was applied.

400.description: The code is invalid, expired or already used.

409.description:
Invitation code only: the invited Representative already
belongs to an Organization.

get.summary: Get the profile of the logged-in Representative
get.description:
Returns the Representative's data, their Organization (if any),
the state of all Organization applications, and the published
registration records that the Organization controls.

patch.description:
Edits the first/last name and/or email address. Name changes are
applied to the authentication service and the database. An email
change is not applied immediately: a validation code is sent to the
new address, which is reported as `pendingEmail` until validated via
`POST /codes/validate`. The old address stays in use until then.

409.description: The new email address is already in use.

post.description:
Creates a new Organization and makes the logged-in Representative
its member. Only possible if the Representative does not yet
belong to an Organization. The Organization ID must be unique
against all Organization IDs and all Organization IDs included in
published WRP registration records.

409.description:
The Representative already belongs to an Organization, or the
Organization ID is already in use.

404.description: The Representative does not belong to an Organization.

patch.description:
Edits the Organization data without external review. This only
affects internal bookkeeping; published WRP registration records are not
changed. A new Organization ID must be unique against all other
Organization IDs and all Organization IDs in WRP registration records published
by other Organizations. All Representatives of the Organization are
notified by email.

404.description: The Representative does not belong to an Organization.

409.description: The new Organization ID is already in use.

post.summary: Invite a Representative to the Organization
post.description:
Sends an invitation code by email to a registered Representative
who does not belong to an Organization. The code is accepted via
`POST /codes/validate`.

404.description: No registered Representative has this email address.

409.description: The invited Representative already belongs to an Organization.

post.description:
Submits an application on behalf of the Representative's
Organization. The application is created at state `pending` and
is tied to the Organization. All Representatives of the
Organization are notified by email. Only applications of
Organizations that participate in APTITUDE are accepted by the
Registrar.

* `create`: applies to publish a new registration record. `wrpId`
  must equal the value of one of `data.identifier`, and must not be
  the WRP ID of any published registration record.
* `edit`: replaces the data of a published registration record
  controlled by the Organization. The WRP ID cannot be changed or
  removed from `data.identifier`. Intended uses that carry an
  existing `intendedUseIdentifier` are kept; intended uses without
  one are new; existing intended uses left out are ended (they get a
  `revokedAt` date and remain in the record).
* `revoke`: applies to remove a published registration record
  controlled by the Organization from the Register.

On acceptance, the Registrar-provided data is added: `registryURI`,
and `intendedUseIdentifier` and `createdAt` for new intended uses.
Registration certificates are issued afterwards by the Provider of
WRPRC and recorded by the Registrar.

201.description: The application was created at state `pending`.

404.description: `edit`/`revoke` only: no published registration record with this WRP ID is controlled by the Organization.

409.description: `create` only: a published registration record with this WRP ID already exists.

get.summary: Get an application of the Organization

post.description:
Transitions a pending application of the Organization to state
`withdrawn`. No further transitions are possible. All
Representatives of the Organization are notified by email.

409.description: The application is not in state `pending`.

The Representative is deactivated, or is not a member of the
Organization required by the operation.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

JwsWrpArrayResponse.description: JWS-signed list of matching Wallet-Relying Party entries, serialized as an application/jwt JWS compact string. Once decoded and signature-verified, the JWT payload conforms to the SignedWRPArray schema defined in the components block: an array of WalletRelyingParty objects matching the query (postalAddress excluded from each published entry), plus issuer/timestamp metadata and cursor-based pagination. Where relevant, the associated WRPAC/WRPRC history MAY be carried per the Member State profile.

X-Next-Cursor.description: Convenience mirror of the signed pagination.next_cursor value inside the payload: cursor to pass as the cursor query parameter on the next GET /wrp request. Absent on the last page.

schema.description: A JWS-signed JWT in compact serialization format. The JWT payload, once decoded and verified, conforms to the SignedWRPArray schema defined in the components block of this specification.

JwsBooleanResponse.description: JWS compact string containing a signed intended-use check result.

schema.description: A JWS-signed JWT in compact serialization format. The JWT payload, once decoded and verified, conforms to the SignedIntendedUseCheckResult schema defined in the components block of this specification.

JwsWrpResponse.description: JWS compact string containing a signed payload with a single WRP registration record.

schema.description: A JWS-signed JWT in compact serialization format. The JWT payload, once decoded and verified, conforms to the SignedWRP schema defined in the components block of this specification.

password.description: Initial password, stored only in the authentication service.

email.description: The validated email address currently in use.

pendingEmail.description: A new email address awaiting validation, if any.

organizationId.description: For invitations, the ID of the joined Organization.

id.description:
Globally-unique Organization ID, supplied by the Representative.
The format is out of the scope of this API.

active.description: False if the Representative account is deactivated.

controlledRecords.description: Published registration records controlled by the Organization.

The WRP ID of the published record to edit. `data.identifier` must still contain it.

data.description: The submitted registration record data (`create` and `edit` only).

submittedBy.description: ID of the Representative who submitted the application.

history.description: Logged state transitions of the application.

submittedByName.description: Name of the submitting Representative, recorded at submission (stays available if they later leave the Organization).

RegistrationCertificate.description: A WRP registration certificate (WRPRC) issued by the Provider of WRPRC for one intended use and recorded by the Registrar. Extension to the APTITUDE Register Data Schema (the Common Register API allows WRPRC history to accompany published entries).

intendedUseIdentifier.description: The intended use the certificate is issued for.

certificateIdentifier.description: Identifier of the certificate, if any.

format.description: `jwt`: JWS compact serialization; `cwt`: base64url-encoded CBOR Web Token.

SignedWRPArray.description: Decoded payload of the application/jwt response for GET /wrp. This models the signed JWT payload (the response body itself is the application/jwt JWS compact string). It mirrors the SignedWRPArrayEnvelope profile of the registry specification and the SignedWRPArray schema of the EUDI harmonised registrar API (TS5).

iss.description: Issuer, the identifier of the Registry/Registrar issuing the statement.

iat.description: Issued-at timestamp (Unix epoch seconds) at which the JWT was issued.

data.description: Array of WalletRelyingParty objects matching the query (published view, postalAddress excluded). Where the Member State profile provides it, each entry MAY be accompanied by its WRPAC/WRPRC certificate history.

SignedWRP.description: Decoded payload of the application/jwt response for GET /wrp/{identifier}. It mirrors the SignedWRPEnvelope profile of the registry specification and the SignedWRP schema of the EUDI harmonised registrar API (TS5).

iss.description: Issuer, the identifier of the Registry/Registrar issuing the statement.

iat.description: Issued-at timestamp (Unix epoch seconds) at which the JWT was issued.

SignedIntendedUseCheckResult.description: Decoded payload of the application/jwt response for GET /wrp/check-intended-use. It mirrors the SignedIntendedUseCheckEnvelope profile of the registry specification (and corresponds to the SignedIntendedUseCheckResult schema of the EUDI harmonised registrar API, TS5). Per Annex VI the check result is a signed boolean; a Member State profile MAY instead carry the richer TS5 object form (isRegistered plus optional details).

iss.description: Issuer, the identifier of the Registry.

iat.description: Issued-at timestamp (Unix epoch seconds) at which the JWT was issued.

data.description: Result of the intended-use check: true if the queried intended-use identifier, credential/claim or privacy policy is registered for the Wallet Relying Party's intended use, false otherwise.

Pagination.description: Cursor-based pagination metadata carried inside the signed SignedWRPArray payload.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to use to fetch the next page of results. Absent or null on the last page.

has_next_page.description: Whether there is a further page of results.

WalletRelyingParty.description: Wallet-Relying Party registration object. In published API statements, postalAddress is excluded.

postalAddress.description: Postal addresses of the legal entity. Registration view only; excluded from published API statements.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or EU for providers operating in the Union.

providerType.description: Provider subtype. For WRP records, typically WalletRelyingParty.

x5c.description: X.509 certificate chains for provider services.

srvDescription.description: Array of service descriptions, each being an array of localized strings.

intendedUse.description: Required if the entity is not an intermediary.

isPSB.description: Whether the WRP is a public sector body.

providesAttestations.description: Required if the entity is a PID or attestation provider.

registryURI.description: URI of the API of the national register of WRPs.

usesIntermediary.description: If present, indicates designated intermediary entries. Only the subset identifier, tradeName, and registryURI is needed for each entry.

isIntermediary.description: Whether the registered entity is a designated intermediary. Shall be false if usesIntermediary is present.

purpose.content: Verify the customer is of legal age for restricted product purchases.

WalletRelyingPartyIntermediary.description: Reference to a Wallet-Relying Party acting as a designated intermediary. Only the subset needed to identify and locate the intermediary is carried here (see the usesIntermediary note in the registry specification).

registryURI.description: URI of the API of the national register where the intermediary is registered.

identifier.description: Identifier value of the legal entity.

intendedUseIdentifier.description: Registry-level unique identifier for the intended use.

createdAt.description: Validity start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

revokedAt.description: End date for the validity of the intended use in YYYY-MM-DD format.

purpose.content: Ouvrir un compte bancaire à distance.

policyURI.description: URL where the policy is published.

meta.description: Additional grouping or type metadata defined per credential format.

path.description: Non-empty path array of strings, nulls, or non-negative integers.

establishedBylaw.description: Required if the entity is a public sector body responsible for authentic sources.

examples.legalBasis: Established under national banking supervision law.

PublishedWalletRelyingParty.description: A published registration record as returned by the Common Register API: the `WalletRelyingParty` snapshot taken when the latest create/edit application was accepted, without `postalAddress`, plus the extension properties `wrpId`, `organizationId` and `registrationCertificates`.

wrpId.description: The WRP ID: the value of one of the record's identifiers (extension).

organizationId.description: Organization ID recorded in the snapshot (extension).

registrationCertificates.description: Recorded registration certificates, including revoked ones (extension).

intendedUseIdentifier.description: Omit for new intended uses. In edit applications, include the identifier of an existing intended use to keep it (possibly modified); existing intended uses left out are ended.

IntendedUseSubmission.description: An intended use as submitted in an application (without Registrar-provided data).

WalletRelyingPartySubmission.description: Registration record data as submitted in create/edit applications: the APTITUDE `WalletRelyingParty` without the Registrar-provided `registryURI`, `intendedUseIdentifier` (for new intended uses), `createdAt` and `revokedAt`.

postalAddress.description: Postal addresses of the legal entity. Registration view only; excluded from published API statements.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or EU for providers operating in the Union.

providerType.description: Provider subtype. For WRP records, typically WalletRelyingParty.

x5c.description: X.509 certificate chains for provider services.

srvDescription.description: Array of service descriptions, each being an array of localized strings.

intendedUse.description: Required if the entity is not an intermediary.

isPSB.description: Whether the WRP is a public sector body.

providesAttestations.description: Required if the entity is a PID or attestation provider.

usesIntermediary.description: If present, indicates designated intermediary entries. Only the subset identifier, tradeName, and registryURI is needed for each entry.

isIntermediary.description: Whether the registered entity is a designated intermediary. Shall be false if usesIntermediary is present.

RegistrationRecord.description: A published registration record, as seen by members of the controlling Organization (full data, including `postalAddress`).
